# BudgetSplit (chat block)

• BudgetSplit(income (static), parts (static), title? (static), currency? (static))
  - Description: An income split into parts as a donut ring with draggable boundaries.
  - income: Monthly income to split.
  - parts: 2 to 5 parts whose percents sum to 100.
    List of maps keys:
    * label - Name of the part, e.g. Needs.
    * percent - Share of income in percent.
  - title: Card title. Defaults to "Monthly budget".
  - currency: ISO currency code. Defaults to INR.

BudgetSplit(income, parts, title?, currency?) — a monthly income as a donut ring with a draggable handle on each boundary; dragging (or arrow keys) moves percent between the two neighbours, amounts recompute live in the browser. parts = [{label, percent}], 2 to 5 parts summing to 100. Use it for 'split my salary / 50-30-20 budget' questions. Sends no events; put Suggestions under it so the user's tap carries the dragged split. Example: card = BudgetSplit(80000, [{label: "Needs", percent: 50}, {label: "Wants", percent: 30}, {label: "Savings", percent: 20}])
